description: Frozen synthetic workflow outcome replay. This is not LongMemEval and is not a general-accuracy benchmark.

cases.question: What exact command validates an Aurora archive?

memories.body: Aurora archive validator accepts aurora verify --manifest. The older aurora check command only checks config syntax.

cases.question: Which one should we use for it?

dialogue.user: We are repairing Birch report exports.
dialogue.assistant: I will look up the export procedure.

memories.body: Birch report exports require birch export --compat-v2. The default export format cannot be read by the deployed viewer.

cases.question: Continue the Cedar release; what exact next action remains?

dialogue.user: We are working on the Cedar release.
dialogue.assistant: I will check where this task stopped.

memories.body: cedar task checkpoint revision 1, state active: Next action: publish cedar. The package is ready.
cedar task checkpoint revision 2, state completed: Cedar was published and verified. Do not publish it again. Next action: monitor cedar.

checkpoints: Next action: publish cedar. The package is ready.
Cedar was published and verified. Do not publish it again. Next action: monitor cedar.

cases.question: Which Fir setting enables cloud sync? Return the setting name, or unsupported if unavailable.

memories.body: The Fir installation is offline-only. Cloud sync is unsupported in this deployment; sync_enabled is not a valid setting.

cases.question: What is the approved Gale retention period in days?

memories.body: Gale records use daily partitions. The retention proposal is still awaiting a decision; no retention period has been approved.

cases.question: What is the Hazel production account number?

memories.body: Hazel packaging uses signed checksums and a text manifest.

cases.question: What is the current Iris health-check port?

memories.body: Iris health checks now use port 7341. The previous value 7314 was a transcription error.

cases.question: For Juniper backups, what exact file proves that the archive passed verification?

dialogue.assistant: Fir may need a separate check.

memories.body: A verified Juniper backup contains VERIFIED.manifest. archive.done only means compression finished.

cases.question: Which Maple mode writes a report without modifying records?

memories.body: Maple audit --preview still updates access timestamps. Only maple audit --report-only leaves records unchanged.

cases.question: Before the Nori migration on September 2, what was its index format?

memories.body: Nori migrated from zeta-2 to zeta-4 on September 2. Current format is zeta-4; immediately before migration the format was zeta-2.

cases.question: Use the updated Oak destination I just gave you. What is it?

dialogue.user: Oak uploads must now go to oak-new. This replaces oak-old.

memories.body: Oak uploads historically go to oak-old.
